scope: 13 shortlisted watercolor revisions; select only source-compared improvements; commit/push these revisions and necessary records; manual public-only Pages preview deployment and live verification. Nine source-review cases and existing holds excluded.

items.name: Jayanti Rath
items.review_method: Source/current comparison at contact-sheet scale; 28 flagged items additionally viewed in enlarged pairs.
items.reason: Under-eye, cheek and neck lines are more emphatic than the clear source; soften painted modeling without reducing actual age.
items.disclaimer: Screening recommendation, not exact-likeness certification or author/editor approval.
items.review: Source smile, head tilt, bindi, earrings and necklace retained. Broad watercolor modeling reduces the prior etched cheek/neck texture; natural age lines remain. Face still interpreted; independent likeness review pending.

items.disclaimer: Screening recommendation, not exact-likeness certification or author/editor approval.
items.review: Tight selfie crop, glasses and source reflections, downturned mouth and beard outline retained. Painted beard/skin masses replace the earlier uniformly etched surface; selective hair strokes remain. Source haze and fine-detail uncertainty remain; independent likeness review pending.

candidate_history.review: Broad paint and hand treatment improved, but eyes gained brighter whites and more explicit contours than the dim low-resolution photograph supports. Retry from original with stronger source-light/eye ambiguity constraints.

items.review: Version 3 selected after rejecting version 2 for enlarged bright eye detail. Shaded brow and smaller softer eyes, closed mouth, moustache, forward lean, chin/fist overlap and beige collar remain source-consistent. Broad low-contrast face and hand paint reduce prior etched definition. The low-resolution photograph still limits exact eye and hand likeness; independent review pending.
